inspection.status.draft.description: Inspection status label: the 'draft' stage of the inspection lifecycle (blueprint inspections/README.md lifecycle; owner decision: neutral codes with these stages as defaults).

inspection.status.assignable.description: Inspection status label: the 'assignable' stage of the inspection lifecycle (blueprint inspections/README.md lifecycle; owner decision: neutral codes with these stages as defaults).

inspection.status.assigned.description: Inspection status label: the 'assigned' stage of the inspection lifecycle (blueprint inspections/README.md lifecycle; owner decision: neutral codes with these stages as defaults).

inspection.status.in_progress.description: Inspection status label: the 'in progress' stage of the inspection lifecycle (blueprint inspections/README.md lifecycle; owner decision: neutral codes with these stages as defaults).

inspection.status.inspector_review.description: Inspection status label: the 'inspector review' stage of the inspection lifecycle (blueprint inspections/README.md lifecycle; owner decision: neutral codes with these stages as defaults).

inspection.status.supervisor_review.description: Inspection status label: the 'supervisor review' stage of the inspection lifecycle (blueprint inspections/README.md lifecycle; owner decision: neutral codes with these stages as defaults).

inspection.status.client_review.description: Inspection status label: the 'client review' stage of the inspection lifecycle (blueprint inspections/README.md lifecycle; owner decision: neutral codes with these stages as defaults).

inspection.status.completed.description: Inspection status label: the 'completed' stage of the inspection lifecycle (blueprint inspections/README.md lifecycle; owner decision: neutral codes with these stages as defaults).

inspection.status.rejected.description: Inspection status label: the 'rejected' stage of the inspection lifecycle (blueprint inspections/README.md lifecycle; owner decision: neutral codes with these stages as defaults).

inspection.kind.inspection.description: Inspection kind: a standard inspection filled in from a template against an asset (blueprint inspections/README.md).

inspection.kind.itp.description: Inspection kind: an inspection and test plan whose steps carry hold, witness, review and surveillance points (blueprint inspections/README.md).

inspection.kind.rfi.description: Inspection kind that is a hold point, not a request for information (owner decision: keep RFI as hold point).

itp.point_type.hold.description: ITP point type label: a point that blocks downstream tasks until released (blueprint inspections/README.md).

itp.point_type.witness.description: ITP point type label: a point that notifies with a notice period and waiver rule (blueprint inspections/README.md).

itp.point_type.review.description: ITP point type label: a review point on an ITP step (blueprint inspections/README.md).

itp.point_type.surveillance.description: ITP point type label: a point that is sampled rather than checked every time (blueprint inspections/README.md).

itp.step.status.pending.description: ITP step status label: the step is pending (blueprint inspections/README.md, itp_steps status pending/ready/in_progress/released/waived/rejected).

itp.step.status.ready.description: ITP step status label: the step is ready (blueprint inspections/README.md, itp_steps status pending/ready/in_progress/released/waived/rejected).

itp.step.status.in_progress.description: ITP step status label: the step is in progress (blueprint inspections/README.md, itp_steps status pending/ready/in_progress/released/waived/rejected).

itp.step.status.released.description: ITP step status label: the step is released (blueprint inspections/README.md, itp_steps status pending/ready/in_progress/released/waived/rejected).

itp.step.status.waived.description: ITP step status label: the step is waived (blueprint inspections/README.md, itp_steps status pending/ready/in_progress/released/waived/rejected).

itp.step.status.rejected.description: ITP step status label: the step is rejected (blueprint inspections/README.md, itp_steps status pending/ready/in_progress/released/waived/rejected).

inspection.source.manual.description: Inspection source: created by a user from the register or the create wizard (INSPECTIONS-01).

inspection.source.scope_task.description: Inspection source: spawned by a scope-of-work task (INSPECTIONS-01; SCOPEWORK-03 creates these).

inspection.source.reinspection.description: Inspection source: a re-inspection of an earlier performed inspection (INSPECTIONS-01).

inspection.source.import.description: Inspection source: brought in by a data import (INSPECTIONS-01).

inspection.error.asset_not_found.text: That asset does not exist or is not visible to you.
inspection.error.asset_not_found.description: Error message for ASSET_NOT_FOUND when creating an inspection (INSPECTIONS-01).

inspection.error.template_not_published.text: That form template has no published revision to inspect with.
inspection.error.template_not_published.description: Error message for TEMPLATE_NOT_PUBLISHED when creating an inspection (INSPECTIONS-01).

inspection.error.no_inspection_workflow.text: No inspection workflow is set up for this tenant or project.
inspection.error.no_inspection_workflow.description: Error message for NO_INSPECTION_WORKFLOW: no active approvals definition for the inspection record type (INSPECTIONS-01).

inspection.error.not_completed.text: Only a performed inspection can be re-inspected.
inspection.error.not_completed.description: Error message for NOT_COMPLETED when re-inspecting an inspection that is not yet performed (INSPECTIONS-01).

inspection.error.revision_mismatch.text: That form revision is not a published revision of the chosen template.
inspection.error.revision_mismatch.description: Error message for REVISION_MISMATCH when the named revision is unpublished or belongs to another template (INSPECTIONS-01).

inspection.error.not_editable.text: Answers cannot be changed while the inspection is in this state.
inspection.error.not_editable.description: Error message for INSPECTION_NOT_EDITABLE: answers are saved only in the states ADR 0041 §6 allows (INSPECTIONS-02).

inspection.error.unknown_field.text: That question is not on this inspection's form.
inspection.error.unknown_field.description: Error message for UNKNOWN_FIELD: an answer names a field key the pinned form revision does not have (INSPECTIONS-02).

inspection.error.answer_invalid.text: One or more answers are not valid for their questions.
inspection.error.answer_invalid.description: Error message for ANSWER_INVALID: an answer has the wrong type, is not one of the options or is out of range (INSPECTIONS-02).

inspection.error.field_not_visible.text: That question is hidden by an earlier answer, so it cannot be answered.
inspection.error.field_not_visible.description: Error message for FIELD_NOT_VISIBLE: an answer names a field that the current answers hide (INSPECTIONS-02).

inspection.error.duplicate_answer.text: The same question or answer id appears more than once in this save.
inspection.error.duplicate_answer.description: Error message for DUPLICATE_ANSWER: one save repeats a field key or a client id (INSPECTIONS-02).

inspection.error.review_permission_requi.text: Only a supervisor allowed to edit during review can change answers now.
inspection.error.review_permission_requi.description: Error message when answers are saved in supervisor review without approvals.inspection.review, 'Edit Inspection during Review' (INSPECTIONS-02, ADR 0041 §6).

itp.action.ready.description: ITP step action label: 'ready' moves a step from pending to ready (for a witness point, notice is given) (INSPECTIONS-03).

itp.action.start.description: ITP step action label: 'start' moves a step from ready to in progress (INSPECTIONS-03).

itp.action.reopen.description: ITP step action label: 'reopen' moves a step from rejected back to in progress (INSPECTIONS-03).

itp.decision.approve.description: ITP sign-off decision label: approve releases a hold, review or surveillance point (INSPECTIONS-03).

itp.decision.witnessed.description: ITP sign-off decision label: witnessed releases a witness point (INSPECTIONS-03).

itp.decision.waived.description: ITP sign-off decision label: waived skips a witness point after its notice period (INSPECTIONS-03).

itp.decision.reject.description: ITP sign-off decision label: reject sends the step back with a comment (INSPECTIONS-03).

itp.signatory_role.inspector.description: ITP sign-off signatory role label: the signer signs as inspector (INSPECTIONS-03).

itp.signatory_role.supervisor.description: ITP sign-off signatory role label: the signer signs as supervisor (INSPECTIONS-03).

itp.signatory_role.third_party.description: ITP sign-off signatory role label: the signer signs as third party (INSPECTIONS-03).

itp.error.not_an_itp.text: Steps can only be added to an ITP.
itp.error.not_an_itp.description: Error message for NOT_AN_ITP: steps were posted to an inspection whose kind is not itp (INSPECTIONS-03).

itp.error.itp_locked.text: Steps can no longer be changed: this ITP has started.
itp.error.itp_locked.description: Error message for ITP_LOCKED: steps are set up only while the ITP is draft, assignable or assigned (INSPECTIONS-03).

itp.error.duplicate_seq.text: Another step already has that number.
itp.error.duplicate_seq.description: Error message for DUPLICATE_SEQ: two steps of one ITP share a seq (INSPECTIONS-03).

itp.error.itp_not_in_progress.text: A step can only be started while its ITP is in progress.
itp.error.itp_not_in_progress.description: Error message for ITP_NOT_IN_PROGRESS: start was taken while the ITP is not in_progress (INSPECTIONS-03).

itp.error.invalid_step_action.text: That cannot be done to the step in its current status.
itp.error.invalid_step_action.description: Error message for INVALID_STEP_ACTION: the action or decision does not apply to the step's status or point type (INSPECTIONS-03).

itp.error.blocked_by_hold.text: An earlier hold point must be released first.
itp.error.blocked_by_hold.description: Error message for BLOCKED_BY_HOLD: a lower-seq hold point is not released or waived (INSPECTIONS-03).

itp.error.step_on_hold.text: This step is on hold for a non-conformance and cannot be released.
itp.error.step_on_hold.description: Error message for STEP_ON_HOLD: an NCR hold flag is set on the step (INSPECTIONS-03).

itp.error.notice_not_elapsed.text: The witness notice period has not passed yet.
itp.error.notice_not_elapsed.description: Error message for NOTICE_NOT_ELAPSED: a witness point is waived before ready_at plus notice_hours (INSPECTIONS-03).

itp.error.comment_required.text: Add a comment to waive or reject a step.
itp.error.comment_required.description: Error message for COMMENT_REQUIRED: waive and reject need a comment (INSPECTIONS-03).

itp.error.countersign_pending.text: A sign-off on this step is waiting for a countersign.
itp.error.countersign_pending.description: Error message for COUNTERSIGN_PENDING: only the pending decision may be countersigned (INSPECTIONS-03).

itp.error.self_countersign.text: Someone else must countersign your sign-off.
itp.error.self_countersign.description: Error message for SELF_COUNTERSIGN: the signer of a pending sign-off tried to countersign it (INSPECTIONS-03).

itp.error.countersign_assurance_required.text: A countersign needs a stronger sign-in than yours.
itp.error.countersign_assurance_required.description: Error message for COUNTERSIGN_ASSURANCE_REQUIRED: the countersigner's assurance is below the tenant's minimum (INSPECTIONS-03).

itp.error.step_already_released.text: The step is already released, so it cannot be put on hold.
itp.error.step_already_released.description: Error message for STEP_ALREADY_RELEASED: an NCR hold was placed on a released or waived step (INSPECTIONS-03).

itp.error.step_already_held.text: Another non-conformance already holds this step.
itp.error.step_already_held.description: Error message for STEP_ALREADY_HELD: a second issue tried to hold the step (INSPECTIONS-03).

itp.error.hold_mismatch.text: Only the non-conformance that holds this step can release the hold.
itp.error.hold_mismatch.description: Error message for HOLD_MISMATCH: the hold was cleared with a different issue (INSPECTIONS-03).

inspection.guard.not_ready_to_submit.text: Release or waive every ITP step before handing in.
inspection.guard.not_ready_to_submit.description: Guard message when Request Supervisor Review is refused because ITP steps are still open (openStepCount > 0) (INSPECTIONS-03).
